# 📖 Inception - User Documentation

Welcome to the Inception project. This document provides the essential commands and instructions for an end-user or system administrator to operate the web infrastructure.

## 🚀 1. Starting and Stopping the Stack

The entire infrastructure is managed via a centralized Makefile located at the root of the repository.

* **Start the infrastructure:**
  Run `make` or `make all`. This will boot NGINX, WordPress, and MariaDB in the background.
* **Stop the infrastructure gracefully:**
  Run `make down`. This safely powers off the containers without destroying your data.
* **Hard Reset (Warning - Destroys Data):**
  Run `make fclean`. This will completely wipe all containers, networks, and physical database files from the host machine.

## 🌐 2. Accessing the Website and Admin Panel

Ensure your local `/etc/hosts` file maps `127.0.0.1` to `oishchen.42.de` before attempting to access the site.

* **Public Website:** Open your browser and navigate to `https://oishchen.42.de`
* **Administrator Dashboard:** Navigate to `https://oishchen.42.de/wp-admin/`

*Note: Because the infrastructure uses self-signed SSL certificates, your browser will show a security warning. You must click "Advanced" and "Proceed" to view the site.*

## 🔐 3. Managing Credentials

All system credentials (passwords and usernames) are strictly managed via environment variables.

* **Location:** Credentials are stored in the `.env` file located at `srcs/.env`.
* **To change passwords:** You must update the `.env` file, perform a total clean (`make fclean`), and rebuild the architecture (`make`) for the new credentials to be injected into the MariaDB core during its first boot sequence.

## 🩺 4. Basic System Checks

If the website is unreachable, you can check the health of the system:

* **View System Dashboard:**
  Run `make debug`. This command displays the status of all containers, active networks, volumes, and prints the last 30 lines of system logs.
* **View Live Traffic:**
  Run `make logs` to watch real-time server activity. Press `Ctrl+C` to exit.
